summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest, 11/11 PASS) and frontend (Playwright mobile 390x844) testing of Feira da Casa app. All auth, products, shopping-list, recipes (GPT-4o), receipt scan/commit, community prices and family-sharing endpoints work. Frontend register flow auto-redirects to /lista with all 5 tabs (Lista/Estoque/Receitas/Comunidade/Perfil). 10 seeded products visible in Estoque, low-stock auto-items in Lista, Perfil exposes btn-invite/btn-join/btn-logout.

minor.issue: allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False — fine for Bearer-token clients, but cookie-based login won't work cross-origin from browser. Acceptable since frontend uses Bearer.
Code generation uses token_urlsafe(5) then transforms; can collide. unique index will raise 500 on rare collision. Consider retry loop.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated. Non-blocking but should be cleaned.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo doctor warns: @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@3.0.2 (expected 2.2.0), expo-image-picker 55.0.19 (expected ~17.0.11), expo-linear-gradient 55.0.13 (expected ~15.0.8), react-native-svg 15.15.4 (expected 15.12.1). App still runs but versions should be aligned.

action_items: Optional: add retry loop in /api/family/invite to handle rare code collisions on the unique index.
Optional: replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow and remove pointerEvents prop usage to silence RN web warnings.
Optional: align Expo SDK package versions flagged by expo doctor.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 727 lines — within the 700 soft limit but consider splitting into routers (auth/products/recipes/receipts/community/family) for maintainability.
EmailStr accepted but normalized only on register/login; otherwise good.
Receipt commit: float coercion of unit_price wrapped in try via 'or 0' works, but no validation of negative numbers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — register, navigation, tabs, seeded data, perfil controls all verified

seed_data_creation: Several TEST_-prefixed users/products/community-prices were created during testing; safe to leave (prefixed) or purge later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Bearer-token auth via Authorization header works against https://smart-shopping-95.preview.emergentagent.com. test_feiradacasa.py covers full E2E. GPT-4o (Emergent LLM key) returns recipes in ~5s and accepts a tiny PIL-generated JPEG for /receipts/scan. Frontend testIDs all present and aligned with the request spec.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failing issue. Initial test_receipt_scan failure was a malformed hex literal in the test fixture; fixed by generating a real JPEG with PIL.
